plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Peplink router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 23695).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Peplink or Pepwave router (DEVICE.mib deviceCpuLoad) as a 0-100 percentage. The SYNTAX is INTEGER(0..100); the value is used as-is and is not divided by 100. Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, WAN steering churn, or attack traffic.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: This metric reports the total physical memory of the Peplink or Pepwave router (DEVICE.mib deviceTotalMemory). The raw OID is in kilobytes and is scaled by 1024 to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the used physical memory of the Peplink or Pepwave router (DEVICE.mib deviceMemoryUsage). The raw OID is kilobytes used and is scaled by 1024 to bytes.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Peplink or Pepwave router, computed as used / total * 100. The kilobyte units cancel, so the ratio is exact. High memory usage may indicate leaks, oversized connection tables, or insufficient capacity.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
